name: Milk Buns
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: 1/2 White Swan Yeast Cake or 1/4 cup hop yeast
ingredients.originalText: 1/2 White Swan Yeast Cake or 1/4 cup hop yeast
ingredients.quantityText: 1/2 White Swan Yeast Cake or 1/4 cup hop yeast

instructions.text: Let milk come to a boil
When lukewarm put in White Swan Yeast Cake or hop yeast
Add enough flour to make a batter as thick as for sponge cake
Let rise till morning and keep very warm
In morning put in egg and a little salt
Mix as stiff as soft bread
Let rise again till real light
When very light take out on bakeboard and roll out 3/8 inch thick

source.originalInstructions:
1. Let milk come to a boil
2. Stir in sugar and lard
3. When lukewarm put in White Swan Yeast Cake or hop yeast
4. Add enough flour to make a batter as thick as for sponge cake
5. Let rise till morning and keep very warm
6. In morning put in egg and a little salt
7. Mix as stiff as soft bread
8. Let rise again till real light
9. When very light take out on bakeboard and roll out 3/8 inch thick
10. Cut in round cakes
11. Butter and turn over double
12. Pinch ends
13. Let rise 1 hour
14. Bake in quick oven
